water_bottle_tomas: I assumed it was at desk_o1 in the afternoon, but at 13:20 it was at dish_rack_k1. It circulates between dining_table_d1, kitchen_table_k1, nightstand_b1, and cupboard_k1. Check nightstand_b1 for late-night queries (around 22:00-23:00) rather than cupboard_k1.
